whatWasWrongAndWhereItWasFixed.located: filing-instructions.md told the participant 'Maryland charges a filing fee for an expungement petition on a guilty disposition. This packet does not state an amount, because no held source establishes one; ask the clerk.' MD.memo.json's md_pardon_expungement track records rules.fees '$30 (CC-DC-CR-072B).' and conditions its fee_waiver component on 'Where the participant cannot pay the $30 filing fee.' Reproduced here at d4653b258: '$30' occurred zero times in either instruction file.
whatWasWrongAndWhereItWasFixed.rootCause: The sentence is Missouri's, and it is TRUE of Missouri - MO.memo.json says of that track 'No fee figure is published on this track'. Carried into Maryland it asserts an absence the controlling record contradicts. It is the sentence that decides whether a participant brings money to the clerk.
whatWasWrongAndWhereItWasFixed.howFixed: The builder now reads MD.memo.json's md_pardon_expungement track at build time and composes one fee paragraph, used in BOTH instruction files, that quotes rules.fees and rules.feeWaiver verbatim. It THROWS MD_MEMO_STATES_NO_FEE or MD_MEMO_STATES_NO_FEE_WAIVER_RULE if the record stops establishing either, rather than falling back to a no-source sentence. Refusal was exercised: with rules.fees deleted on a scratch copy of the memo the build stops before writing a byte.
whatWasWrongAndWhereItWasFixed.whatStaysUnestablished: The genuinely unestablished element is kept unestablished and is now stated precisely instead of as a blanket absence. The delivered petition prints NO amount - its only fee wording is 'Filing Fees Are Not Refundable' across the top of page 1, confirmed in the source binary and in both delivered fixtures - so the form is not evidence the $30 is current, and nothing held here establishes any other cost of the filing. The copy says so and tells the participant to confirm the amount with the clerk before paying. source-receipt.json's whatThisReceiptDoesNotEstablish was corrected the same way: it no longer says the receipt does not establish the fee (which read as no source does), but that the two source binaries print no amount and the figure comes from MD.memo.json, hashed as a composition source.
whatWasWrongAndWhereItWasFixed.notDone: No fee was invented, no amount was rounded or updated, and nothing here approves $30 as current.
